$comment: Configuration for scripts/ncd-scan.mjs. Paths are repo-root-relative POSIX paths matched as JS regular expressions against the tracked path.
$comment_tags: Tag rules classify every unit. Tags are informational; dropPairTags decides which pairs leave the primary ranked list. Dropped pairs are still reported in a separate section so nothing is silently hidden.
$comment_kinds: Unit kinds to extract. function covers declarations, methods, arrows and function expressions bound to a name; type covers interface and type-alias declarations; sql covers string and template literals that look like SQL.
$comment_reject: Pairs whose two units both fall inside one of these named regions are annotated with the binding rejection from docs/88e6aeb-post-consolidation-design-review.md. Annotation never removes a pair from the list; it marks it so a reviewer does not re-litigate a settled decision.
